answer: Producing a novel, coherent answer each epoch is cheap per alias but prohibitive across thousands, so scale buys less credibility — the attacker cannot simply buy a large, credible flock. This is why the network can stay open without a central gatekeeper: the economics of reputation do the filtering that a trusted authority otherwise would.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a inlet as the anchor of the cost.
